findings.rule: spec.md Requirements ("a glob entry among them is skipped ... noted in ci_settings_file's result")
findings.summary: ci_settings_file writes the diagnostic keys _denyWriteSkipped/_denyWriteNarrowed directly into sandbox.filesystem of the temporary settings.ci.json copy that is passed to the live claude -p --settings invocation, not just returned to the caller, and it is not verified live whether Claude Code's sandbox config loader tolerates an unrecognised key under sandbox.filesystem.
